query: WITH expired AS (SELECT b.workspace_id,b.id FROM assistant_batches b WHERE b.state IN ('completed','cancelled','expired','paused') AND b.finished_at<now()-interval '90 days' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_actions a WHERE a.workspace_id=b.workspace_id AND a.batch_id=b.id) ORDER BY b.finished_at LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) DELETE FROM assistant_batches b USING expired e WHERE b.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND b.id=e.id
